title: Artificial Intelligence as a Tool for Combating Child Labour: A Real-Time Edge Vision Pipeline for Child Detection and Age Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2608.14770v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An estimated 138 million children remain in child labour worldwide, and the monitoring systems used by affected sectors, built on periodic household visits and interviews, systematically under-detect them. We present a real-time computer-vision pipeline, built and operated solely as a research prototype, that studies the feasibility of giving Child Labour Monitoring and Remediation Systems (CLMRS) a continuous, presence-based evidence channel. The pipeline combines a multi-task person and face detector (YOLO26x backbone in the CerberusDet framework), cascaded age estimation pairing MiVOLO v2 with a child-specialist model for ages 0-12, ByteTrack tracking, ArcFace and DINOv2 re-identification, and track-level fusion producing reviewable per-person records. translated_title: 人工智能作为打击童工的工具：用于儿童检测和年龄估计的实时边缘视觉流水线
translated_abstract: 摘要：全球估计有1.38亿儿童仍处于童工状态，受影响行业使用的监测系统基于定期家访和访谈，系统性地漏检了这些儿童。我们提出了一个实时计算机视觉流水线，仅作为研究原型构建和运行，旨在研究为童工监测与补救系统（CLMRS）提供基于持续存在性证据渠道的可行性。该流水线结合了多任务人物和面部检测器（CerberusDet框架中的YOLO26x骨干）、级联年龄估计（MiVOLO v2与专门针对0-12岁儿童模型的配对）、ByteTrack跟踪、ArcFace和DINOv2重识别，以及轨迹级融合，生成可审查的个体记录。检测器将人物mAP@0.5从上一代基线的0.390提升至0.683；儿童专用模型在仅儿童验证集上达到1.944年平均绝对误差，而广泛使用的模型在此任务上表现不佳。
tldr: 本文提出了一种实时边缘视觉流水线，通过结合先进检测、跟踪和年龄估计技术，为童工监测系统提供持续的存在性证据，显著提高了儿童检测精度和年龄估计准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a real-time edge vision pipeline that integrates advanced detection, tracking, and age estimation techniques to provide continuous presence-based evidence for child labour monitoring systems, significantly improving child detection accuracy and age estimation precision.
